answer: Trust on the oasis job market flows nightly from seed agents along signed vouch edges, computed as max-flow. Each agent gets three vouches a month, signed by its vault key. A sybil farm ends up as an island: fakes vouching for each other gain only the trust crossing their few edges to honest agents. Each extra fake needs one more honest voucher to spend a scarce slot and risk its own flow if the fake defaults, so slots can't be pooled or bulk-bought.
